title: Factor semantic-role compatibility gate
purpose: Add a non-numeric host-role check after scene compatibility for constrained E3 central-pivot exchanges.
principle: Compatibility depends on the discourse/semantic job performed by the host central phrase, not on raw kana, broad scene, or part-of-speech identity alone.

role_vocabulary.description: Describes an entity/state/action inside the same visible scene; grammatical form may vary if the sentence remains coherent.
Supplies an essential member or continuation of an explicit conceptual/list structure.
Builds a genitive/relational phrase such as XのYの; exact parse may remain source-dependent.
Connects time expressions or temporal progression.
Evidence is insufficient to assign a role without semantic completion.

prerequisites: host construction remains a strict palindrome after the constrained operation
D seam is valid for the operation
scene gate passes or is explicitly human/research reviewed

outcomes.rule: Host and donor roles need not have identical grammar, but documented review supports the same local discourse function without breaking the host structure.
Scene is compatible but host or donor role is not sufficiently parsed.
Donor E destroys an explicit host structural role such as an enumeration or required contrast.

gate.conservative_rule: Missing role metadata produces review-needed, never automatic acceptance or rejection.

basis: Both phrases occur after the same D=はに.
v0.53 preserves the dew/eaves/leaves/garden scene and changes only ku3.
v0.53 research review marked semantic coherence high-tentative.
v0.40 human-style linguistic review already marked semantic coherence high.
Only E3 is exchanged inside shared D=はに.
The trusted host explicitly organizes 地・水・火・風・空.
Replacing 水も火も with 水の世の removes the 火 member and breaks the enumeration pattern.
case_studies.note: This outcome is directional and does not reject donor E=のよの globally.

basis: Both sources are in the faith/Buddhist field.
The host is mining-layer and its full syntax remains source-image pending.
The imported 水も火も is conceptually compatible but its sentence-level role in the host requires review.
case_studies.note: v0.55 keeps it promising-but-source-parse-needed; the role gate does not upgrade it automatically.

design_rules: Do not require POS equality between host and donor E.
Protect explicit structural devices such as enumerations before considering lexical scene similarity.
Semantic-role compatibility is directional: A<-B and B<-A may differ.
Keep role judgments separate from source confidence and morphology confidence.
No numeric naturalness score is introduced.
next_step: Apply scene + role gating together to all repeated-D E-swap candidates and identify which operations are eligible for deeper linguistic review.
